Name: Domed Garden Pot's mods Compatibility patch for Lumisteria's mods
Author: MariesaMist
Description:
there is a hand copy file, incase your machine doc is already overwritten. you will copy and paste the changes in yourself, you can refer to my "Quaint living" compatibility, where you will just repeat it for each individual pot, or whichever ones you use, if you are lazy like me.
It also contains a machine file, which you will just replace if you have not modified it priorly.

Note, As a way to keep things a little more balanced, I am only doing the last three pots, as you can grow both the tea bushes, as well as regular crops in them.  (Also its a lot of work so :P) I thought that it would be a nice encouragement to push forward in the game, to slowly phase out certain crops from the rotation :D.

Additionally, there is not a way to have TWO results from a crop, therefore, I decided to make the option to put Fuchsia berries in, and ONLY get them back. Sorry I couldn't find a way to do it :(. It does, however, regrow.

There is a main file, which has both the by hand version, and the machine file
there are also two optional files for each individual mods, both containing the by hand version and the machine file.
